identity.paletteIntent: Stadium charcoal, uncoated ivory, field green, restrained copper and slate. Retain route colors as information, remove neon plates and blanket vintage filters.
identity.typographyIntent: Self-hosted Anton for display, Archivo normal and italic for reading and voice, Space Mono for data and evidence labels. Font copyright and SIL OFL notices remain with the assets.
identity.shapeLanguage: Wide cinematic frames, fine rules, numbered playbook markers. Historical evidence remains visibly separate from reconstructions.
motionGrammar: comparison: uncover the photograph beneath its overpainting
reading: keep text and evidence immediately visible
interactionSignature: Read five Start / Door / Result route strips
Compare original photographic evidence with labeled illustration
Check five evidence claims with explanation
Write three responses using shared account saving and Turn In
identity.densityRhythm: Five NFL cases and one other-sport case, five evidence calls, three written responses of 90–110 words. Alternative 35–45 minute assignment, not the second half of a required sequence.
identity.archivalBehavior: Original photographs are separately preserved outside the deployable tree. Date every later portrait. Reconstructed scenes carry persistent labels. Source-to-ink comparison explains preserved evidence and invented surfaces.
identity.endingLanguage: Three equal-length responses use historical facts and image evidence. independent evidence evaluation and counterargument.

assetToInterfaceTranslation.paletteSource: Natural field greens and neutral ink shadows from the supplied documentary player-coach benchmark.
assetToInterfaceTranslation.edgeTreatment: Fine ivory or charcoal rules around images, small offset details on evidence only.
assetToInterfaceTranslation.controlLanguage: Readable playbook labels and native buttons; image comparison controls describe source and interpretation.
assetToInterfaceTranslation.spacingLanguage: Wide gutters between panels like a comic page, tight stacks inside props.
assetToInterfaceTranslation.transitionLanguage: Reading content is immediately visible. Controlled evidence reveals and route drawing carry meaning; reduced motion retains static content.

assignmentContract.distribution: Alternate A and B across seats; students complete one assignment only.
